description:
A team of long-lived bots for DeepSeek Harness.

DeepSeek Bot (DS Bot) is a bot plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that turns DSH into long-lived bots. You create your own bots, then talk and work with them, with bot-to-bot messages and group chats.

The desktop app brings its own DSH, so you do not need to install DSH first. Bots can run tools, keep their own memory and files, and answer side questions while they work.
Changed
- Cleaner activity row: replaced the permanently visible bordered "Move to background" pill on the inline activity row with a borderless action revealed smoothly on hover, keyboard focus, or touch tap, keeping the status line quiet at rest. (#2388)
Fixed
- Bot private chat tool cards & compaction bars: fixed a v0.4.0 desktop frontend regression that showed raw tool call cards (such as MCP and shell tools) and compaction bars in Bot private chats; Bot mode now keeps non-Bot tools quiet while preserving live activity phrases, nested Bot cards, persisted computer-use screenshots across restarts, and full developer tool cards in Classic Agent mode. (#2386)
- Per-Bot Mailbox connector toggle: fixed the Mailbox switch in Bot details bouncing back on (and overwriting other Bots' disabled states) by returning offFor in mailView(), and unmounted Agent-scoped mail_* tools when Mailbox is turned off for a Bot. (#2391)
